display.purpose: Page titles. Fixed 1.75rem ceiling — no fluid clamp, no hero scale.

headline.purpose: Big numeric values (stat cards) and prominent section headings.

title.purpose: Dialog titles, detail-panel titles, card headings.

body.purpose: Table cells, descriptions, general prose (cap at 65–75ch).

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked column headers, detail labels, stat labels, sidebar section titles.

shadows.name: action-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary-button hover only — a brief blue-tinted lift confirming the action is live.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft inner ring on focused inputs, paired with a primary-colored border.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Color/background/border transitions on buttons, inputs, rows, nav.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing (Tailwind ease-in-out) for state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action. Dispatch Blue fill, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; background: var(--color-primary, #0B4EA2); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #fff); border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-base, 4px); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Work Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #03285A); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #0B4EA2) 25%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, #22D3EE); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary .ds-ico { font-style: normal; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis row/toolbar action. Outline that fills blue on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #DBE5F0); border-radius: var(--radius-base, 4px); background: transparent; color: var(--color-body, #365261); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Work Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-secondary, #E8F1FF); border-color: var(--color-primary, #0B4EA2); color: var(--color-primary, #0B4EA2); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, #22D3EE); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Text input with a leading icon; primary border + glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; max-width: 400px; } .ds-search-ico { position: absolute; left: 0.875rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--color-body, #365261); pointer-events: none; } .ds-input-search { width: 100%; padding: 0.625rem 0.875rem 0.625rem 2.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #DBE5F0); border-radius: var(--radius-base, 4px); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Work Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-heading, #0B161F); background: var(--color-background, #F8FBFF); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input-search:focus { border-color: var(--color-primary, #0B4EA2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #0B4EA2) 10%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status-first pill — the most repeated atom in the app.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 100px; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Work Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--color-secondary, #E8F1FF); color: var(--color-secondary-foreground, #0B4EA2); }

components.name: Priority Badge
components.description: Pill with a leading dot; semantic color pair per priority.
components.css: .ds-priority { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 100px; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Work Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: capitalize; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-priority-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-priority--urgent { background: var(--color-muted-destructive, #FFE1DE); color: var(--color-destructive, #FF4B4B); } .ds-priority--urgent .ds-priority-dot { background: var(--color-destructive, #FF4B4B); } .ds-priority--low { background: var(--color-muted-success, #D1EDE0); color: #065F46; } .ds-priority--low .ds-priority-dot { background: var(--color-success, #3DBE81); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Flat, bordered metric card with an icon well. No resting shadow.
components.html:
◷
128Open tickets
components.css: .ds-stat-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; background: var(--color-background, #F8FBFF); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #DBE5F0); border-radius: var(--radius-base, 4px); padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; } .ds-stat-icon { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-base, 4px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.125rem; flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--color-secondary, #E8F1FF); color: var(--color-primary, #0B4EA2); } .ds-stat-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.125rem; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: var(--font-heading, 'Poppins', sans-serif); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: var(--color-heading, #0B161F); } .ds-stat-label { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Work Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--color-body, #365261); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar link; active fills Wash Blue, hover is a 60% wash.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Work Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-body, #365261); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-secondary, #E8F1FF) 60%, transparent); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: var(--color-secondary, #E8F1FF); color: var(--color-secondary-foreground, #0B4EA2); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-ico { font-style: normal; opacity: 0.8; }

narrative.overview: Meedo is the surface where Geoplan/Geosense staff move work through a queue — tickets, attendance, leads — so the whole system is built like a dispatch desk: status reads first, the next action is one click away, and nothing on screen is there to impress. The aesthetic is crisp and efficient in the lineage of Linear: tight type, flat surfaces structured by thin borders, a single confident blue for action, and a quiet near-white canvas that lets dense data lead. It rejects cluttered legacy enterprise, playful consumer UI, and over-animated marketing motion; motion is reserved for conveying state.
keyCharacteristics: Status-first: a ticket, attendance entry, or lead reads its state before anything else.
Flat by default; thin 1px borders do the structural work, not shadows.
One blue carries every primary action; cyan is a focus/accent signal, not decoration.
Fixed rem type scale (no fluid clamp) — sized for consistent on-desk viewing.
Sharp edges: small radii, crisp corners; rounding is restraint, not softness.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one action color: Dispatch Blue. If a button, link, or active state needs to say 'this is the thing to act on,' it is this blue or it is wrong. Cyan is for focus, not action.

rules.name: The Information-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Color always carries meaning (state, selection, focus). A colored surface that means nothing is decoration — remove it.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are fixed rem values, never clamp(). Users view at a consistent desk DPI; a headline that shrinks inside a sidebar looks worse, not better.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow is a verb, not a noun — it only appears in response to hover or focus. If a card has a resting shadow, it's wrong; give it a border instead.

rules.name: The Sharp Edge Rule
rules.body: Default to sharp: 4px on buttons/cards/inputs, 6px on nav items. The 100px status/priority pills are the single deliberate exception. Do not soften the system with rounded-lg/rounded-xl; crispness is the brand.

rules.name: The Earned-Familiarity Rule
rules.body: Every interactive element ships its full state set — default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading. The Save button looks identical in every module; if it differs, one is wrong.

dos: Do use theme tokens (bg-primary, text-body, border-border, var(--primary), …) for every color. Hex literals belong only in app.preset.ts and styles.css.
Do keep one action color (Dispatch Blue) and reserve Signal Cyan for focus rings and accents.
Do keep surfaces flat with 1px Hairline borders; let shadows appear only on hover/focus.
Do keep type on the fixed rem scale (display ceiling 1.75rem) and lean on Poppins for headings/numbers, Work Sans for everything read.
Do ship skeletons for loading and teaching empty states; pair every status color with text or an icon (never color alone).
Do keep edges sharp (4px / 6px); the pill is only for status/priority badges.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion and keep transitions at 150–250ms, conveying state only.
donts: Don't drift toward cluttered legacy enterprise — no busy toolbars, gray-on-gray, or deeply nested menus. Density must stay hierarchical and scannable.
Don't make it feel like a playful consumer app — no bright gamified surfaces, emoji, mascots, or casual copy.
Don't add over-animated / flashy marketing motion — no decorative gradients, glassmorphism, scroll choreography, or hero-metric template tiles.
Don't introduce a warm cream/sand body background; the canvas is a cool near-white (#F8FBFF).
Don't soften the system with large radii (rounded-lg/rounded-xl) or resting card shadows.
Don't keep hardcoding amber/orange for warning states — promote a warning / muted-warning token pair into the theme instead of inline off-theme hex.
Don't use gradient text, side-stripe (border-left) accents, or nested cards.
